correctness.rationale: For distinct variables and lax team semantics, dep(x_1)∨...∨dep(x_r) holds precisely if r coordinate hyperplanes, one per coordinate, cover the team. A noncoverable possibly infinite team has a finite noncoverable subteam by induction on r using a base row s* and counterwitness sets T_i of rows differing in coordinate i. For an inclusion-minimal finite noncoverable F, covering F\{s} after deleting s yields a_i(s) distinct from s_i, and P_s(X)=∏_i(X_i-a_i(s)) evaluates nonzero at s and zero at each other row. These |F| multilinear polynomials are linearly independent in a 2^r-dimensional space, implying |F|≤2^r. The Boolean cube {0,1}^r itself is noncoverable, but every proper subset is coverable by choosing complementary hyperplanes of an excluded row; sharp. Independent complete enumerations for (arity,alphabet) (1,4),(2,2),(2,3),(3,2),(4,2) corroborated obstruction sizes and diagonal evaluations; the polynomial proof is universal.
